name: mtb.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 3 JSON-LD blocks do not parse.
lesson: Validate each JSON-LD block after every release. One stray comma hides all of it.
summary: www.mtb.com scores 64 out of 100 (D). 7 checks fail now, 31 are at risk, and 37 pass. Fix first: tracking starts before the visitor chooses.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Ads (2 requests), Meta Pixel (1 request), Adobe Analytics (1 request), and cookies TAPID on tealiumiq.com, cg_uuid on obs.segreencolumn.com, test_cookie on…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: 3 JSON-LD blocks do not parse
fix.evidence: On /es, /personal/mortgages-and-loans/mortgages, /homepage/about-us/sustainability/report. A block that is not valid JSON is ignored by Google and by AI crawlers.
fix.fix: Validate each block with the Schema Markup Validator and fix the JSON.

fix.title: ARIA attributes must conform to valid names
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 2 elements on /homepage/about-us, /help-center, for example a[aria-page="current"]. Impact: critical.

fix.title: Tracking continues after Reject
fix.evidence: After pressing "Reject All" and reloading, Google Ads (4 requests), Meta Pixel (1 request), Adobe Analytics (2 requests), and new cookies IDE on doubleclick.net still appeared.
fix.fix: Map every tag in the consent tool to a category and block it until that category is accepted.

fix.title: 15 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /personal/mortgages-and-loans/mortgages. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 20 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
The start page arrived in 123 ms
Every page has a meta description
